final: WITH invoice_counts AS (SELECT o.order_id, COUNT(i.invoice_number) AS invoice_count FROM Orders AS o LEFT JOIN Invoices AS i ON i.order_id = o.order_id GROUP BY o.order_id), shares AS (SELECT invoice_count, 1.0 * invoice_count / SUM(invoice_count) OVER () AS share FROM invoice_counts), average_share AS (SELECT AVG(share) AS value FROM shares) SELECT SUM(s.invoice_count) AS total_invoices, AVG(s.share) AS average_share, AVG(s.share - a.value) AS average_excess FROM shares AS s CROSS JOIN average_share AS a WHERE s.share > a.value
